description:

 This Lot applies to both Large and small bone orthopaedic power tools but not precision tools, for which there is a separate lot.  This Lot applies to consumables and accessories for orthopaedic power tools including specialist and precision tools. We require Bone Cement & Bone Cement Mixing Systems for use in NHSS invasive orthopaedic surgical procedures. This will be used in an acute setting across NHSS by suitably trained personnel. We require Orthopaedic Bone Cement Accessories for use in NHSS invasive orthopaedic surgical procedures. This will be used in an acute setting across NHSS by suitably trained personnel. We require Pulse Lavage irrigation systems for use in NHSS invasive orthopaedic surgical procedures. This will be used in an acute setting across NHSS by suitably trained personnel. We require Tourniquet Cuffs (Disposable, Reusable & Semi-Reusable) for use in NHSS invasive orthopaedic surgical procedures. This will be used in an acute setting across NHSS by suitably trained personnel. We require Tourniquet Cuffs Accessories for use in NHSS invasive orthopaedic surgical procedures. This will be used in an acute setting across NHSS by suitably trained personnel. Bidders are requested to submit details of any items they offer, which are suitable for inclusion in this Orthopaedic Power Tools, Bone Cement, Mixers, Pulse Lavage & Tourniquets Framework for acute procedures but, by their description, cannot be submitted in any of the lots 1-8.  For absolute clarity, no item included here should be present in your bid for any other lot, and priority should be given to inclusion in defined and scored lots where possible. Bidders to this lot MUST have included bids to one or more of the scored lots 1-8 on this tender to qualify.

title: NP57426 Condoms & Sexual Health Products
description:
This Lot covers the supply of sexual health and pregnancy testing products for use across NHS Scotland. Products may include, but are not limited to, pregnancy tests, HIV tests, syphilis tests and combination sexual health testing products. The Framework is intended to support the delivery of sexual health services by providing access to clinically appropriate, compliant and value for money diagnostic products across participating authorities. Lot 3 is a multi supplier unranked award, it evaluated and awarded independently of all other Lots.
 Tenderers may bid for this Lot without submitting a tender for any other Lot. This Lot covers the provision of added value services that support the delivery of sexual health services across NHS Scotland. Services may include, but are not limited to, products, educational resources, awareness campaigns, training materials, patient information, health promotion initiatives and other value-added activities designed to improve sexual health outcomes and support service delivery.
 This is an unranked and unscored Lot.
 Tenderers will be required to provide details of the added value services they propose to offer as part of their framework participation. Suppliers successfully awarded a place on Lot 1, Lot 2 and/or Lot 3 will automatically be awarded a place on Lot 4. Appointment to Lot 4 does not form part of the scored evaluation process and Tenderers will not be ranked for this Lot. This Lot covers innovative products, services and solutions that support the delivery and continuous improvement of sexual health services across NHS Scotland. Innovation proposals may include, but are not limited to, new product developments, technological advancements, service enhancements, packaging innovations, environmental improvements and other initiatives that deliver additional value and improved outcomes for patients and participating authorities.
 This is an unranked and unscored Lot.
 Tenderers will be invited to describe any innovative products, services or initiatives that they can offer as part of their framework participation. Suppliers successfully awarded a place on Lot 1, Lot 2 and/or Lot 3 will automatically be awarded a place on Lot 5. Appointment to Lot 5 does not form part of the scored evaluation process and Tenderers will not be ranked for this Lot. This Lot covers the supply of loose condoms and lubricants for use across NHS Scotland. Products may include, but are not limited to, standard latex condoms, large condoms, latex-free condoms, extra-thin condoms, flavoured condoms, textured condoms, internal condoms and associated lubricants. The Framework is intended to support sexual health services by providing access to clinically appropriate, compliant and value for money products throughout Scotland.
